newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear power unit hikes production.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear power unit hikes production.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear unit began to increase power output after Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) requested its operation be reduced last weekend, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The plant in Richland, Wash., was producing at 89 percent power, NRC said in its Monday plant status report.
Last week, BPA, which markets power from WNP-2, asked the plant operator to cut the nuclear unit's output to 70 percent due to plenty of cheap, hydroelectric supplies in the Pacific Northwest.
Since mid-January, WNP-2 was running below full capacity because of problem with an adjustable speed drive.
WNP-2 is operated by Washington Public Power Supply System, and owned by a consortium of Washington public utilities.
